long_biography.plain_text:
Prestige Properties & Development began in 1984 with Sam Shalem and Irving Pergament as co-founders. The firm concentrated on Class A retail and office properties, pairing acquisitions with development and long-term management. Its Bay Plaza work in the Bronx grew from a community shopping centre into a broader retail complex.

Shalem has continued to lead Prestige as chief executive and principal. Under his direction, the company has acquired institutional-scale shopping centres across the Northeast and Florida, including Riverhead Centre and Greenleaf at Union. Prestige serves as property sponsor and manager on major financings, with Shalem also acting as a personal guarantor; the underlying buildings remain company or borrower-entity assets.
